do [ -f "$f" ] || echo "MISSING INPUT $f"; done; jq empty $(git ls-files "*.json") || echo "INVALID JSON"; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.skills // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; *) echo "NO .md EXTENSION $p";; esac; done; grep -Fxf skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md | awk "length > 60" | grep -vFxf docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt | sed "s/^/DUPLICATED /"; BT=$(printf "\140"); jq -r ".plugins[] | "\(.name)	\(.description)"" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | while IFS="$TAB" read -r name desc; do H="### $BT$name$BT"; grep -qxF "$H" CLAUDE.md || { echo "DESC NO HEADING $name"; continue; }; line=$(awk -v h="$H" "p { print; exit } \$0 == h { p = 1 }" CLAUDE.md); [ -n "$line" ] || { echo "DESC BLANK AFTER HEADING $name"; continue; }; [ "$line" = "$desc." ] || echo "DESC DRIFT $name"; done; grep -oE "^### $BT[^$BT]+$BT" CLAUDE.md | tr -d "#$BT " | while read -r h; do echo "$NAMES" | grep -qxF "$h" || echo "DESC NO PLUGIN $h"; done; jq -r ".plugins[].name" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | while read -r p; do H="### $BT$p$BT"; mk_s=$(jq -r --arg p "$p" ".plugins[] | select(.name == \$p) | (.skills // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sed "s|.*/||" | sort -u); mk_c=$(jq -r --arg p "$p" ".plugins[] | select(.name == \$p) | (.commands // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sed "s|.*/||; s|\.md\$||" | sort -u); SC=$(awk -v h="$H" "\$0 == h { p = 1; next } p && /^#/ { exit } p" CLAUDE.md); SR=$(awk -v h="$H" "\$0 == h { p = 1; next } p && /^#/ { exit } p" README.md); cl_s=$(printf "%s
" "$SC" | sed -n "s/^\*\*Skills:\*\* *//p" | tr "," "
" | tr -d "$BT " | grep . | sort -u); cl_c=$(printf "%s
" "$SC" | sed -n "s/^\*\*Commands:\*\* *//p" | tr "," "
" | tr -d "$BT " | grep . | sort -u); rd_s=$(printf "%s
" "$SR" | sed -n "s/^| *$BT\([^$BT]*\)$BT *|.*/\1/p" | sort -u); [ "$mk_s" = "$cl_s" ] || echo "SKILLS DRIFT $p claude"; [ "$mk_s" = "$rd_s" ] || echo "SKILLS DRIFT $p readme"; [ "$mk_c" = "$cl_c" ] || echo "COMMANDS DRIFT $p claude"; done; w2n() { case "$1" in one) echo 1;; two) echo 2;; three) echo 3;; four) echo 4;; five) echo 5;; six) echo 6;; seven) echo 7;; eight) echo 8;; nine) echo 9;; ten) echo 10;; eleven) echo 11;; twelve) echo 12;; thirteen) echo 13;; *) echo 0;; esac; }; for f in skill/*/SKILL.md; do nums=$(grep "^## Phase [0-9]" "$f" | sed "s/^## Phase *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/" | sort -n -u); cnt=$(printf "%s
" "$nums" | grep -c .); [ "$cnt" -eq 0 ] && continue; [ "$nums" = "$(seq 1 "$cnt")" ] || echo "PHASE SEQUENCE $f (numbered $(echo $nums | tr "
" " ")- expected 1 to $cnt)"; said=$(sed -n "s/.*[Tt]he \**\(one\|two\|three\|four\|five\|six\|seven\|eight\|nine\|ten\|eleven\|twelve\|thirteen\)\** phases.*/\1/p" "$f" | head -1); [ -n "$said" ] || continue; [ "$(w2n "$said")" = "$cnt" ] || echo "PHASE COUNT DRIFT $f (says $said, has $cnt)"; done; n=$(awk "/^## Verification/ { v = 1; next } v && /^## / { exit } v" README.md | grep -c "^# "); said=$(sed -n "s/.*[^A-Za-z]\([A-Za-z][a-z]*\) checks:.*/\1/p" CLAUDE.md | head -1 | tr A-Z a-z); [ "$(w2n "$said")" = "$n" ] || echo "CHECK COUNT DRIFT CLAUDE.md says $said, README has $n"; reg_c=$(jq -r ".plugins[] | (.commands // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sed "s|.*/||; s|\.md\$||" | sort -u); doc_c=$(awk "/^## Commands/ { v = 1; next } v && /^## / { exit } v" README.md | sed -n "s|^/\([A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\).*|\1|p" | sort -u); for c in $reg_c; do printf "%s
" "$doc_c" | grep -qxF "$c" || echo "COMMAND UNDOCUMENTED $c"; done; for c in $doc_c; do printf "%s
" "$reg_c" | grep -qxF "$c" || echo "COMMAND NOT REGISTERED $c"; done; ip_n=$(grep "^## Phase [0-9]" skill/init/SKILL.md | sed "s/^## Phase *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/" | sort -n -u | grep -c .); ip_said=$(sed -n "s/.*[^A-Za-z]\([a-z][a-z]*\) ordered phases.*/\1/p" CLAUDE.md | head -1); [ "$(w2n "$ip_said")" = "$ip_n" ] || echo "INIT PHASE COUNT DRIFT CLAUDE.md says $ip_said, skill/init/SKILL.md has $ip_n"; } 2>&1 ); [ -z "$bad" ] && echo "structural checks pass" || { echo "$bad"; exit 1; }'
